prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1440; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give a recorded statement today. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.
Q: That works. Can you tell me where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was stopped at a red light on the main road in League City, near the shopping center.
Q: Were you moving at the time of impact?
A: No, my car was completely stopped and I had my foot on the brake.
Q: What happened next?
A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped back and then forward, and my seatbelt locked up across my chest.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?
A: Yes, but I felt stiff and my lower back was already aching. The other driver came over and apologized.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon. They took X-rays and said it looked like a back strain.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes. Sitting for long periods makes the pain worse, and I've had trouble sleeping on my left side.
Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?
A: I've been on light duty for a few days. My supervisor let me sit more and avoid lifting.
Q: Did you have any pain or injuries before this collision?
A: No, not to my back. I had no problems like this before.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want my treatment covered and my car repaired as soon as possible. Thank you.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
